description: Post-practical-estimate saturation ramp (§8.3): starts from the 24,985 TPS ceiling and increases by 25% each tier until a stop condition fires. Identifies the true node throughput limit and classifies the bottleneck as load-driver-, node-, database-, L1-provider-, or infrastructure-side.
walletProvisioningNote: external-key mode — set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY to a pre-funded key whose UTxOs are initialized on the node before running replay scenarios
